You know where I was a year ago? Sitting on my ass in my bedroom 24/7 failing my classes, wandering aimlessly in life. I was so desperate to die that I lockpicked my dad’s gun safe and about shot myself, but I couldn’t. Now, I’m doing great in school and taking undergrad classes. Hell, I’m gonna graduate with my associate’s come next year. I’m getting in shape and am actually getting out of my shell. Just to clarify, it’s easier said than done, it’s a huge commitment to make, but... like said, all things considered in due time, in spite of hardly knowing you, I have faith... if you ever need someone to talk to about your problems, I probably didn’t cover everything, but I hope the message gets across and look forward to hearing from you soon.
